text:
sylvie: heads-up — deploy-bot failed to tag the canary during the 03/21 release window, got a publish reject with 'provenance annotation mismatch'. anyone oncall?

deploy-bot: publish rejected: KMS_ANNOTATION_MISSING for repo=redwood/runtime-canary tag=canary-2026-03-21 attempt=1. HTTP 403 from ecr-put-manifest. No automatic fallback configured.

jamal: ouch. copying the last few lines from the deploy logs:
```
[2026-03-21T15:20:11Z] buildbot: pushed layer sha256:... to eu-west-1
[2026-03-21T15:20:12Z] cosign: signature uploaded, attestation=present
[2026-03-21T15:20:13Z] ecr: put-manifest failed status=403 message="missing KMS annotation for signing key region mismatch"
```

ana_ops: tagging in eu uses a different KMS alias now after rotation. sounds like the attestation was signed with us-east1 key but the ecr repo in eu expects an annotation that points to eu KMS. buildbot env might still be setting KMS_REGION=us-east1.

buildbot: confirmed: CI job `canary-publish` uses KMS_REGION from secrets-manager, last rotation changed alias in prod only. staging and canary builders were not updated. cosign sig exists but annotation payload points to different kms_key_arn.

sylvie: plan proposal: pin the canary tag back to the last-known-good digest, do a manual promote to keep the release window moving. then create a follow-up to fix builder secrets and run a quick cross-region attestation test. any objections? :thinking_face:

jamal: +1. i'll manual-promote to the previous digest sha256:0a1b2c3d and update release notes. can someone add a rollback threshold?

ana_ops: set rollback crit: if canary error rate >5% for 10m or CPU spike >30% vs baseline, revert to stable. also add note to release notes: "Canary tag pinned due to KMS annotation mismatch; fix underway."

jamal: doing manual promote now. running `deployctl promote --repo redwood/runtime-canary --from-digest sha256:0a1b2c3d --to-tag canary-2026-03-21 --manual-reason "KMS annotation mismatch"`

deploy-bot: manual promote completed by jamal at 2026-03-21T15:22:05Z. canary now points to sha256:0a1b2c3d. note: tag history preserved.

ana_ops: created INFRA-472 to track: "sync KMS alias across build fleets + add attestation integration test (eu/us)". assigned to @jamal and @buildbot. ETA: EOW.

jamal: updated release notes: "Action: canary tag pinned to previous digest after transient KMS annotation mismatch during publish. No runtime changes. Root cause: builder secret not rotated for eu builders. Follow-up ticket INFRA-472." :memo:

sylvie: thanks all. merge window stays open. please post when INFRA-472 has the test coverage so we can remove the manual pin step next week. :thumbsup:

buildbot: will run cross-region attestation smoke tomorrow morning and report in #eng-infra.

jamal: closing thread, will file a short changelog entry in the release notes doc and mark the canary step as manual-pinned in the deployment runbook.
